title: Output-Feedback Controller Synthesis for Dissipativity and $H_2$ Performance of Autoregressive Systems from Noisy Input-Output Data
summary: In this paper we propose a data-driven output-feedback controller synthesis method for discrete-time linear time-invariant systems in the form of autoregressive model with exogenous input. The synthesis goal is either to achieve dissipativity with respect to a given quadratic supply rate, or to achieve given $H_2$ performance level. It is assumed that the model of the plant is unknown, except for the disturbance term.
